declarations.description:
The Skip Links component is a text element used for keyboard based navigation. Skip links only appear when tabbed to, they are not
intended for mouse users. They usually are added to a page to be the first tab stop and thus offer functionalities such as "Skip to
content" or access to "a11y user settings".
The targets of the skip links would be sections such as the main tag or active elements. Some browsers require a tabindex=-1 value
on non-interactive elements such as the main tag or some div to properly move focus along. Also the focused elements should show the
skipped-to focus so the movement is clear to the end user.

events.name: input

events.description: Fired when the search query is submitted by clicking on the Search button or pressing enter key. The custom event contains an `event.detail` property which contains an `options` and a `searchstring` object. For each selectable menuitem in the search options you must provide an `id` attribute on the menuitem with an unique internal id. The search options use the `id` attribute to identify the selection. The `detail.options` in the search event contains for each selected item: + itemid: the given unique internal id of the menuitem + checked: true + name: deprecated, contains also the given internal id; replaced by itemid **Note:** The event will not be fired if the `disabled` property is set to `true`.
